# KRN repository rules

This file is already loaded as CLAUDE.md; do not read it again. Small change: edit, run `npm run fast` once (biome --write, tsc, related tests, one verdict), commit; CI runs the rest.

- **KRN-05** When core code is changed, the author MUST keep imports within core _(owner: author; test: core imports only its own files, including nested files and every module form; Core stays independent of replaceable adapters.)_
- **KRN-06** When the CLI receives an unknown command, the CLI MUST fail with exit 64 and a message naming the command, and MUST NOT forward it to any other binary _(owner: CLI; test: unknown and retired commands exit 64 with a clear stderr message and print nothing to stdout; A removed command fails loudly instead of showing a stale legacy help screen with exit 0; no legacy install remains to forward to.)_
- **KRN-07** When a change is ready for integration, the author MUST obtain a successful full Product aggregate `Check` from GitHub Actions (App `15368`) on the exact HEAD _(owner: author; gate: npm run gate; Full required CI is the only gate: lint, typecheck and touched tests run locally, then auto-merge on the Check; review and local gates are opt-in.)_
- **KRN-08** When agent state is written for this repository, the author MUST keep agent state under `.krn/` _(owner: author; test: project tools ignore nested worktree state; Agent state is repository-local and stays outside tracked project inputs.)_
- **KRN-09** When the lead works in this repository, the lead MUST follow `docs/program/lead-rules.md` for evidence, proposals, handoffs, and delivery _(owner: lead; none: manual review; Lead methods have one durable owner.)_
- **KRN-10** When an agent works in this repository, the agent MUST follow `docs/program/repository-workflow.md` for the local KRN delivery process and terminal PR closeout _(owner: all KRN roles; none: manual review; KRN process belongs only in repositories that explicitly adopt it; the global contract stays universal and minimal.)_
- **KRN-11** When a work item is managed, the lead MUST manage task status in `tasks/<id>.json` with `krn task` (`ready`, `claim`, `release`, `close`); workers MUST NOT mutate tracker state, must receive the task id in their brief, and MUST use it in commit titles and the `Ticket:` trailer (`Refs:` while the task stays open) _(owner: lead; none: manual review; Work status travels with the repository and delivery remains traceable to its task.)_
- **KRN-12** When code is integrated or forwarded, the author MUST test every integration or forward against its real receiver or a verbatim capture of its output _(owner: author; none: manual review; Receiver-boundary evidence verifies integration and forwarding contracts.)_
- **KRN-13** When the lead works in this repository, the lead MUST keep context bounded: delegate reading to a subagent returning a verdict and path, pass pointers instead of file contents, verify by commands that print a verdict, run independent slices as parallel worktree lanes with background agents, and hand off at the context-gauge advisory with `krn-handoff` _(owner: lead; none: manual review; Fresh sessions restart from durable files instead of accumulating context.)_
- **KRN-14** When a defect is fixed, the author MUST add its regression test at the lowest layer that reproduces it _(owner: author; none: manual review; Low-layer tests fail fast and name the broken unit.)_
